question.text: Which of the following is NOT a criterion for determining a 'fit and proper person' under SEBI regulations?

explanation.text: The Logic: Fit-and-proper assessment may consider integrity, honesty, ethical behaviour, reputation, fairness and character, and disqualifications such as pending criminal complaint/charge sheet, restraint or debarment orders, insolvency/wilful default, or being found of unsound mind. A minimum age of 35 years is not listed in the checked criteria. The Trap: The other options each map to a listed criterion or disqualification, while the minimum age requirement is not part of the fit-and-proper framework checked in the source. Note: Source pages 44-45 of Series XIX-A AIF (Category I and II) Distributors workbook.
